name: Kuruma Tabi
description: Kuruma Tabi is a quiet block theme for private chauffeured sightseeing tours that serve one family at a time. The home page opens on a split hero: a documentary photograph of a driver-guide holding a van door open at a mountain viewpoint fills the right half, the title sits beside it, and a white tab with an evergreen day-timeline bar runs flush along the bottom. It continues with a welcome, one horizontal line for the day, three mirrored route rows with line drawings crossing the seam, a fare table on a pale evergreen band, a lead guide portrait with a docked caption tab beside a thumbnail list, three circular vehicle photographs, guest stories under a parallax photograph, questions and one itinerary request. Hanken Grotesk for headings, Public Sans for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce and without a forms plugin. WCAG AA colours; quiet scroll effects that respect reduced motion.
